Vertices, Edges, Faces from FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors(M)
M : CellMesh

V, E, F, C = ElementSets( M )
`∂⁰`, `∂¹`, `∂²` = BoundaryMatrices(M) 
`B⁰`, `B¹`, `B²` = UnsignedBoundaryMatrices(M)
`B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
`B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
`B²ᵀ` = `B²`ᵀ

VertexOneRing(v) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector({v})))) - {v} where v ∈ V
VertexOneRing(v) = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` (`B⁰ᵀ` IndicatorVector(v)))) - v where v ⊂  V

EdgeIndex(i, j) = eset_1  where i,j ∈ V,
eset = Edges(i) ∩ Edges(j)

NeighborVerticesInFace(f, v) = tuple(vset1_1, vset2_1) where v ∈ V, f ∈ F,
es = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂¹` IndicatorVector({f}))),
nes = { s for s ∈ es if `∂⁰`_v,s != 0 },
eset1 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1},
vset1 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset1))) - {v},
eset2 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = 1 },
vset2 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset2))) - {v}

NextVerticeInFace(f, v) = vset_1 where v ∈ V, f ∈ F,
eset = { e for e ∈ Edges(f) if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1},
vset = Vertices(eset) - {v}

OrientedVertices(f) = tuple(vs_1, i, j)    where f ∈ F,
vs = Vertices(f),
i,j = NeighborVerticesInFace(f, vs_1)

OrientedVertices(c) = tuple(l, i, j, k)    where c ∈ C,
fset = Faces(c),
pfset = { f for f ∈ fset if `∂²`_f,c = 1 },
i,j,k = OrientedVertices(pfset_1),
remain = Vertices(c) - Vertices(pfset_1),
l = remain_1

FaceIndex(i,j,k) = fset_1  where i,j,k ∈ V,
ufv = `B¹ᵀ` `B⁰ᵀ`,
iface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({i}))),
jface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({j}))),
kface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv IndicatorVector({k}))),
fset = iface ∩ jface ∩ kface

OrientedVertices(i,j,k) = NeighborVerticesInFace(f, i)  where i,j,k ∈ V,
f = FaceIndex(i, j, k)

`B⁰`, `B¹`, `B²` = UnsignedBoundaryMatrices(M)

`B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ

"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        self.F = rhs[2]
        self.C = rhs[3]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()

        self.M = M
        _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors = self.FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors(M)
        self.Vertices = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices
        self.Vertices_0 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices_0
        self.Vertices_1 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices_1
        self.Vertices_2 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices_2
        self.Vertices_3 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices_3
        self.Vertices_4 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices_4
        self.Vertices_5 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Vertices_5
        self.Edges = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Edges
        self.Edges_0 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Edges_0
        self.Edges_1 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Edges_1
        self.Edges_2 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Edges_2
        self.Faces = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Faces
        self.Faces_0 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Faces_0
        self.Faces_1 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Faces_1
        self.Faces_2 = _FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors.Faces_2
        rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
        self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
        self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
        self.dee2 = rhs_1[2]
        rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
        self.B0 = rhs_2[0]
        self.B1 = rhs_2[1]
        self.B2 = rhs_2[2]
        # `B⁰ᵀ` = `B⁰`ᵀ
        self.B0T = self.B0.T
        # `B¹ᵀ` = `B¹`ᵀ
        self.B1T = self.B1.T
        # `B²ᵀ` = `B²`ᵀ
        self.B2T = self.B2.T

    def VertexOneRing(self, v):
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V

        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator({v}, self.M.n_vertices()))) - {v}

    def VertexOneRing_0(self, v):
        v = frozenset(v)
        return nonzeros(self.B0 @ (self.B0T @ indicator(v, self.M.n_vertices()))) - v

    def EdgeIndex(self, i, j):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V

        # eset = Edges(i) ∩ Edges(j)
        eset = frozenset.intersection(self.Edges_0(i), self.Edges_0(j))
        return sorted(eset)[1-1]

    def NeighborVerticesInFace(self, f, v):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V
        assert f in self.F

        # es = edgeset(NonZeros(`∂¹` IndicatorVector({f})))
        es = nonzeros(self.dee1 @ indicator({f}, self.M.n_faces()))

        # nes = { s for s ∈ es if `∂⁰`_v,s != 0 }
        NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1 = set()
        set_range = es
        for s in set_range:
            if(self.dee0.tocsr()[v, s] != 0):
                NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1.add(s)
        nes = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_1

        # eset1 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
        NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2 = set()
        set_range_1 = nes
        for e in set_range_1:
            if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2.add(e)
        eset1 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_2

        # vset1 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset1))) - {v}
        vset1 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset1, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}

        # eset2 = { e for e ∈ nes if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = 1 }
        NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4 = set()
        set_range_2 = nes
        for e in set_range_2:
            if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == 1):
                NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4.add(e)
        eset2 = NeighborVerticesInFaceset_4

        # vset2 = vertexset(NonZeros(`B⁰` IndicatorVector(eset2))) - {v}
        vset2 = nonzeros(self.B0 @ indicator(eset2, self.M.n_edges())) - {v}
        return [sorted(vset1)[1-1],sorted(vset2)[1-1]]

    def NextVerticeInFace(self, f, v):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert np.ndim(v) == 0
        assert v in self.V
        assert f in self.F

        # eset = { e for e ∈ Edges(f) if `∂¹`_e,f `∂⁰`_v,e = -1}
        NextVerticeInFaceset_0 = set()
        set_range_3 = self.Edges_1(f)
        for e in set_range_3:
            if(self.dee1.tocsr()[e, f] * self.dee0.tocsr()[v, e] == -1):
                NextVerticeInFaceset_0.add(e)
        eset = NextVerticeInFaceset_0

        # vset = Vertices(eset) - {v}
        vset = self.Vertices_5(eset) - {v}
        return sorted(vset)[1-1]

    def OrientedVertices(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        # vs = Vertices(f)
        vs = self.Vertices_0(f)

        rhs_3 = self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, sorted(vs)[1-1])
        i = rhs_3[0]
        j = rhs_3[1]
        return [sorted(vs)[1-1],i,j]

    def OrientedVertices_0(self, c):
        assert np.ndim(c) == 0
        assert c in self.C

        # fset = Faces(c)
        fset = self.Faces_2(c)

        # pfset = { f for f ∈ fset if `∂²`_f,c = 1 }
        OrientedVertices_0set_0 = set()
        set_range_4 = fset
        for f in set_range_4:
            if(self.dee2.tocsr()[f, c] == 1):
                OrientedVertices_0set_0.add(f)
        pfset = OrientedVertices_0set_0

        rhs_4 = self.OrientedVertices(sorted(pfset)[1-1])
        i = rhs_4[0]
        j = rhs_4[1]
        k = rhs_4[2]

        # remain = Vertices(c) - Vertices(pfset_1)
        remain = self.Vertices_2(c) - self.Vertices_0(sorted(pfset)[1-1])

        # l = remain_1
        l = sorted(remain)[1-1]
        return [l,i,j,k]

    def FaceIndex(self, i, j, k):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert np.ndim(k) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V
        assert k in self.V

        # ufv = `B¹ᵀ` `B⁰ᵀ`
        ufv = self.B1T @ self.B0T

        # iface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({i})))
        iface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({i}, self.M.n_vertices()))

        # jface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv  IndicatorVector({j})))
        jface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({j}, self.M.n_vertices()))

        # kface = faceset(NonZeros(ufv IndicatorVector({k})))
        kface = nonzeros(ufv @ indicator({k}, self.M.n_vertices()))

        # fset = iface ∩ jface ∩ kface
        fset = frozenset.intersection(iface, frozenset.intersection(jface, kface))
        return sorted(fset)[1-1]

    def OrientedVertices_1(self, i, j, k):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert np.ndim(k) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V
        assert k in self.V

        # f = FaceIndex(i, j, k)
        f = self.FaceIndex(i, j, k)
        return self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, i)
    class FundamentalTetrahedronAccessors:
        def __init__(self, M):
            rhs = M.ElementSets()
            self.V = rhs[0]
            self.E = rhs[1]
            self.F = rhs[2]
            self.C = rhs[3]
            dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
            dime_0 = M.n_edges()
            dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
            self.M = M
            rhs_1 = M.BoundaryMatrices()
            self.dee0 = rhs_1[0]
            self.dee1 = rhs_1[1]
            self.dee2 = rhs_1[2]
            rhs_2 = M.UnsignedBoundaryMatrices()
